rows.name: MT-1 [Multiple cell lines with same name, see Cellosaurus]
rows.llm_verdict: actually Ambiguous: multiple distinct cell lines share the name "MT-1" (e.g., MT-1 human breast cancer line vs MT-1 adult T-cell leukemia line vs MT1 mesothelioma); at least one MT-1 breast cancer line has been found to be cross-contaminated/identical to a HeLa-derived or other line depending on source - specific identity depends on which MT-1 is referenced

rows.name: ALVA-55

rows.name: DRO90-1

rows.name: GT3TKB
rows.llm_verdict: actually TKB (gastric carcinoma cell line, shown to be cross-contaminated with HeLa)
